properties.OutageReportInfo:
Newfoundland and Labrador Hydro wish to advise customers of an unplanned power outage to St. Albans, Milltown and Morrisville. We have located a tree on the feeder going to St.Albans, restoration to head of the bay, Milltown and Morrisville is approximately 10 min and St. Albans approximately 1 Hr. Newfoundland and Labrador Hydro apologizes to its customers for any inconvenience this outage may cause.

Crews are working diligently to restore power. I will provide an update as soon as I hear back from the area supervisor.
